# care-voice

> care-voice is an open-source daily voice check-in agent for older adults who live alone. It runs a short scripted conversation (sleep, medication, food, pain, falls, day of the week, mood), extracts structured answers with an offline rule-based extractor or an optional OpenAI-compatible LLM, applies transparent alert rules against the person's own history in SQLite, and notifies caregivers by console, webhook, or email. It ships a terminal simulator, a caregiver web dashboard with a JSON API, and an experimental Twilio adapter. It is not a medical device and not an emergency service. Python 3.11+, runtime dependency PyYAML only, Apache-2.0.

## Key source files

- [cli.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/cli.py): the `care-voice` command (simulate, history, alerts, validate, serve, call)
- [engine.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/engine.py): `CheckinSession` and `run_checkin`
- [extractors/rules.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/extractors/rules.py): offline rule-based extractor and safety flags
- [extractors/llm.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/extractors/llm.py): optional LLM extractor
- [risk.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/risk.py): alert rules
- [store.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/store.py): SQLite history
- [dashboard.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/dashboard.py): caregiver dashboard and JSON API
- [data/default_script.yaml](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/care-voice/blob/main/src/care_voice/data/default_script.yaml): bundled check-in script
